name: UniqueRowsByKeyNode
label: Unique Rows by Key
description: Removes rows that share the same value in one or more key columns, keeping either the first or last occurrence.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: DataTable
fields.label: Data Table
fields.description: The data table from which duplicate-key rows are removed.

fields.name: KeyColumns
fields.label: Key Columns
fields.description: Comma-separated column names that define uniqueness.

fields.name: KeepFirst
fields.label: Keep First
fields.description: If true, keeps the first occurrence; otherwise keeps the last occurrence.

fields.name: UniqueDataTable
fields.label: Unique Data Table
fields.description: The data table with duplicate-key rows removed.
